use generated_dmn::{Value, evaluate};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
const NS: &str = "urn:rust-proof:dates";
fn decode(value: &str) -> Value {
    match value {
        "N" => Value::Null,
        "T" => Value::Boolean(true),
        "F" => Value::Boolean(false),
        _ => {
            let parts: Vec<_> = value[1..].split(',').collect();
            Value::Date {
                year: parts[0].parse().unwrap(),
                month: parts[1].parse().unwrap(),
                day: parts[2].parse().unwrap(),
            }
        }
    }
}
fn inputs(date: Value, field: Value) -> BTreeMap<(&'static str, &'static str), Value> {
    BTreeMap::from([
        ((NS, "input"), date),
        (
            (NS, "record"),
            Value::Record(BTreeMap::from([("When".into(), field)])),
        ),
    ])
}
#[test]
fn dates_match_java_vectors() {
    let mut count = 0;
    for line in include_str!("date_vectors.tsv").lines() {
        let columns: Vec<_> = line.split('\t').collect();
        let values = evaluate(&inputs(decode(columns[0]), decode(columns[1]))).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(values[&(NS, columns[2])], decode(columns[3]), "{line}");
        count += 1;
    }
    assert_eq!(count, 494);
}
#[test]
fn invalid_date_inputs_are_rejected_at_each_level() {
    for (year, month, day) in [
        (0, 1, 1),
        (1900, 2, 29),
        (2023, 2, 29),
        (-100, 2, 29),
        (2024, 0, 1),
        (2024, 13, 1),
        (2024, 1, 0),
        (2024, 4, 31),
        (-1_000_000_000, 1, 1),
        (1_000_000_000, 1, 1),
    ] {
        let invalid = Value::Date { year, month, day };
        assert!(evaluate(&inputs(invalid.clone(), Value::Null)).is_err());
        assert!(evaluate(&inputs(Value::Null, invalid)).is_err());
    }
    assert!(evaluate(&inputs(Value::Text("2024-02-29".into()), Value::Null)).is_err());
}
